payload.title: Console frontend hygiene: devDependencies, dynamic imports, duplicate modules, helper tests
payload.description: From kbs-29c415: move express, cors, chokidar, express-rate-limit and js-yaml (dev-server only) to devDependencies; dynamic-import mermaid and the MQTT/SigV4 path so the local console bundle does not load them; delete the pre-extraction copies of @kanbus/ui modules (IssueCard.tsx, useBoardTransitions.ts, diverged issue-colors.ts) in favour of the package; add vitest for pure helpers and run it in CI.
